name: php-vanilla-admin
title: Bakkal Panel - small-shop product & order admin
description: Framework-free PHP 8.3 admin panel for a corner grocery: products CRUD, orders with status workflow and admin-only user management. Hand-written router, native PHP sessions, PDO + SQLite.

env.name: APP_ENV
env.description: Set to development to show stack traces on the 500 page.

env.name: APP_KEY
env.description: Read at boot for parity with the other demo apps; not used cryptographically.

env.name: DB_PATH
env.description: Path of the SQLite database file; created and seeded on first request.

auth.description: Native PHP $_SESSION cookie (bakkal_session) with password_hash/password_verify, per-session CSRF token on every POST form, roles admin/staff. /users is admin-only (staff receive 403).

persistence: sqlite file at data/bakkal.sqlite (Docker volume /var/www/html/data), auto-created + seeded with 2 users, 10 products, 6 orders on first request
notes: No Composer, no build step. Docker image runs Apache on 8006 with DocumentRoot=public and mod_rewrite; mount a volume at /var/www/html/data to keep the database. Apache must be able to write to data/ (owned by www-data in the image). For a non-Docker deployment the web server must route all requests to public/index.php.
